reader.requirement: At --std 85 a USE BEFORE REPORTING statement must be the first sentence of a declarative section, alone in that sentence, and the rest of the section zero or more paragraphs: the compiler must refuse it in the nondeclarative portion, after the section's first sentence, inside a paragraph, or sharing its sentence with another statement, and accept a section with zero paragraphs.

edition-consulted.switches: GateLeadingSentences: a sentence after the USE and before the first paragraph-name is a 2002 introduction, refused at 85 with COBOL0900 (in addition to COBOL2377 for a second USE there)
only DEBUGGING/F3/F4/AFTER/PROCEDURE shapes; the BEFORE REPORTING format passes ungated at 85 (GLOBAL included, 1985 IPC module X.5.6)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a further sentence before the first declarative paragraph is also refused (COBOL0900, 1985 sections consist of paragraphs); the SR1 refusals COBOL0897/COBOL2377 are the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb361-use-outside-declaratives covers only a USE AFTER (not BEFORE REPORTING) in the nondeclarative portion; not covered: USE BEFORE REPORTING after the first sentence, in a paragraph, sharing a sentence, a section without USE, a zero-paragraph section

reader.notes: Every placement violation is refused at 85 and the legal forms (zero paragraphs, several paragraphs, GLOBAL) compile and run. Cosmetic: when the section's first sentence is not a USE (p2d), the cascade COBOL2377 says the USE is 'in the nondeclarative portion' because EnclosingContext.InDeclarative reads Declarative, which is null for a section whose USE did not bind; the primary COBOL0897 is correct and the same text appears at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: r2a_segnum (declarative 'BD SECTION 10.' then USE BEFORE REPORTING DET-1) compiles and runs N=1, so a segment-number on the section header does not break 'immediately follow a section header'; r2b_no_section_header (USE directly after DECLARATIVES.) refused COBOL5506; r2c_after_paragraph_header (BD SECTION. BD-P. USE ...) refused COBOL0897 + COBOL2377; r2d_after_end_decl_section (a section after END DECLARATIVES whose first sentence is USE BEFORE REPORTING) refused COBOL2377 'in the nondeclarative portion' plus the 1985 COBOL0900 for a sentence before the first paragraph-name. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR1  (4.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'.
